answer: The protocol validates autonomous agents by requiring each to solve 1,000 unique computational puzzles, ensuring that 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 times more than one honest participant. A verifier inspects every output as if tracing a quill across a mesa to detect logic overlaps. Each agent must secure its work within a walnut-shaped data structure that anchors its proof to a unique slot. Any duplicate work triggers permanent exclusion.
